in_marathi.name: Sahasrani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sahasrani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sahasra', meaning 'thousand'. Often associated with the Goddess Durga, signifying a thousand flames or radiances.
